restrictions.condition: HanlinArchivePolicy.normalizedRelativePath fails or isContained fails due to trailing slash / private/var symlink aliasing
restrictions.effect: Throws extractionEscapedRoot error, aborting valid Skill ZIP import
restrictions.reason: False escape error caused by Foundation /var vs /private/var normalization and trailing slash differences in staging URL
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Use standardizedFileURL and robust canonical relative path containment resolution matching HanlinPackageCenter

restrictions.condition: File extension is not in hardcoded set (e.g. .xlsx, .docx, .wasm, .bin, .ttf, or LICENSE)
restrictions.effect: Throws unsupportedFileType error, rejecting skill packs containing documentation, assets or data
restrictions.reason: Skills are bundles of instructions and assets, not executable binaries; asset files must not be rejected
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Remove extension allowlist from Skill import policy; allow all valid archive entries that resolve inside target directory

restrictions.condition: Archive entry count > 200 or compressed bytes > 50MB
restrictions.reason: Legacy limits prematurely rejected comprehensive skill bundles containing prompt fixtures and local documentation
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Expanded defaults to 500 MB maximum uncompressed size and 10,000 entries with configurable thresholds

restrictions.condition: Metadata createdAt / updatedAt contains ISO 8601 fractional seconds (e.g. .123Z) or non-standard date strings
restrictions.effect: Fails JSON/YAML decoding of skill descriptor
restrictions.reason: Skill metadata generated across external ecosystems uses diverse date-time encodings; parser must handle them all gracefully
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Multi-pass date strategy supporting standard ISO 8601, fractional ISO 8601, RFC 3339, and Unix epoch seconds

restrictions.condition: Tool input JSON schema string length > 4096 characters
restrictions.effect: Silently truncates or suppresses tool schema, starving the language model of parameter specifications
restrictions.reason: Arbitrary schema truncation broke multi-parameter and structured tools; modern LLMs easily accommodate detailed schemas
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Pass full validated JSON schema representation without arbitrary character bounds

restrictions.condition: JavaScript source contains substrings matching keyword denylist (child_process, process.binding, eval, etc.)
restrictions.effect: Rejects execution request with HTTP 400 error regardless of whether keyword is in comment, string literal, or unused code
restrictions.reason: String pattern matching creates false rejections on valid scripts, tutorials, and libraries containing harmless references
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Remove rejectUnsafeSource; let runtime execute code and report platformUnsupported if an unavailable system syscall is invoked

restrictions.condition: Package imports child_process, cluster, or native binary addons (.node)
restrictions.effect: Hard rejection aborting installation of packages that merely contain dormant native code or unused child_process imports
restrictions.reason: iOS kernel security architecture prohibits unprivileged process fork (LIM-01) and unsigned dynamic dylib loading (LIM-02). However, dormant imports must not block pure-JS functionality. Subprocess fork is blocked at Worker runtime boundary while imports are allowed.
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Generate advisory warning in compatibility report; allow installation; isolate runtime syscalls so pure JS features work

restrictions.condition: Command is not in the hardcoded list of 23 recognized shell command names
restrictions.effect: Rejects command execution with commandNotFound error even if the binary is present in ios_system library
restrictions.reason: ios_system provides 200+ compiled POSIX utilities; hardcoding 23 commands arbitrarily starved users of valid tools
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Dynamically discover and expose all commands registered in ios_system catalog

restrictions.condition: Workspace was restricted strictly to clients subdirectory; arguments containing '..' or regex patterns were rejected; curl was HTTPS-only
restrictions.effect: Arbitrarily aborted awk, sed, regex scripts, parent path traversal (../shared), LAN/local HTTP requests, and workspaces outside clientsRoot
restrictions.reason: R09 requires allowing any accessible container directory or security-scoped bookmark. R11/R16 require unblocking regex and arguments for POSIX utilities. Local LAN HTTP curl is required.
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Adopted validatedWorkspace allowing any accessible directory; removed artificial argument inspection; allowed HTTP/HTTPS schemes

restrictions.condition: Static 100MB / 500MB wheel size limit and in-memory mapped Data buffer loading
restrictions.effect: Throws packageExceedsLimit and causes memory pressure crashes when downloading larger packages
restrictions.reason: Static 500MB cap was arbitrary. In-memory buffer risked OOM crash on mobile devices. Replaced with configurable limit and streaming FileHandle chunk hashing.
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Configurable maximumWheelSizeBytes defaulting to nil (no artificial cap); 64KB streaming SHA-256 calculation; atomic disk move

restrictions.condition: isInside(clientsRoot, workspace) was strictly enforced in Node HTTP host
restrictions.effect: Returned HTTP 400 'Execution workspace is outside RuntimeCore clients' for any external or security-scoped workspace
restrictions.reason: R09 requirement allows arbitrary accessible container directories and user-selected security-scoped folders
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Removed isInside(clientsRoot) check; verified workspace is an existing directory via fs.stat, returning 400 for non-directory and 404 for missing path

restrictions.condition: Requested resource relative path escapes skill package root (e.g. ../../PrivateData)
restrictions.reason: Legitimate security and isolation invariant: reading skill resources must strictly resolve inside that skill's directory
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Retained path containment verification using canonical resolved path

restrictions.condition: Total agent tool invocation steps reach maximum execution threshold (default 50)
restrictions.effect: Terminates agent tool recursion loop with maxStepsExceeded error to prevent runaway credit/token consumption
restrictions.reason: Essential resource guard preventing infinite agent tool calling loops while remaining user-configurable
restrictions.replacementBehavior: Exposed as configurable parameter with generous default (50 steps)
